about: The 12 x 10 world (docs/design/world-12x8-scope.md, J-083, J-084): 12 world squares east-west, 8 rows of land with an ice row north and a desert row south (the plan's wall rows), 6912 x 5760 cells, 108 x 90 chunks, and east joins west ("wrap": "ew"). A world file like the nine's ("generated": the seed, the size in world squares, wall rows included, the generator's version, the squares pinned to a map folder); a world that wraps is its whole plan, so the valley is pinned at the plan's own valley square, [0, 5]. Too big to bake whole (about 9-10 GB of cells): "bake": false, so it's planned and known only (GeneratedMap.EnsureBaked refuses it) until the sparse World. Spawn is the valley's moved; expects are read from the known ring over every chunk (9 x 9 samples a chunk), not a bake.
name: The Wide World
